notes.title: Monospaced Lovers Chapter 1 Livestream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36710203/98c633c4dc3599f1747cd84a7e32d3987d5b2e06.gif[/img]

[h2]Ch1 Demo w/ Dev Commentary[/h2]
As part of the Steam Game Festival, we're happy to present a [b]live streaming event[/b] featuring the first chapter of Monospaced Lovers! The lead dev (that's me) will play through the full demo while providing commentary along the way.

The game contains a lot of text, and I'll try to approach the demo as if I'm a first-time player (while trying to ignore the fact that I've speedran it a hundred times). As a result, the stream could last more than an hour, but don't feel bad if you have to leave early.

Will the commentary be useful, or funny, or otherwise interesting? Will the stream run from start to finish without any technical difficulties? The answer to these questions — and more — will be revealed soon. Tune in to find out!
